facts.text: The Augustinian Scholars Program admits 60 first-year students annually, offering awards covering 75% of tuition to roughly 30 scholars.

sources.title: Augustinian Scholarship | Westmont College
sources.quote: Westmont welcomes 60 incoming first-year students to the program each year. The highest financial award level, granted to about 30 of these scholars, covers 75% of tuition.
